examples.name: Labeling
examples.code:
<Flex direction="column" maxWidth="size-3000" gap="size-300">
  <Meter
    label="Space used"
    showValueLabel={false}
    value={90}
    variant="critical" />

  <Meter
    label="Space used"
    valueLabel="54 of 60GB"
    value={90} variant="critical" />

  <Meter
    label="Space used"
    formatOptions={{style: 'percent', minimumFractionDigits: 2}}
    value={89.123}
    variant="critical" />
</Flex>
